## Description

<p class="source-citation"><a href="https://docs.ogc.org/is/18-062r2/18-062r2.html#toc59">Published source: OGC 18-062r2, 1.0.0 (toc59)</a>. Modified Building Blocks rendition of OGC 18-062r2 (2021). This Intellectual Property includes modifications that have not been approved or adopted by the Open Geospatial Consortium (LICENSOR). The published source is an Approved OGC Standard; this reconstructed rendition is not an OGC-approved publication. In case of any discrepancy the published HTML prevails.</p>

<div class="Section3" id="_abstract_test_suite">
<span id="toc59"></span>
<div id="_introduction"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc60">A.1.  Introduction</h2><p id="_056a8482-eb5a-d211-9641-adb8b1cdf711">OGC Web Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) are not Web Services in the traditional sense. Rather, they define the behavior and content of a set of Resources exposed through a Web API. Therefore, an API may expose resources in addition to those defined by the standard. A test engine must be able to traverse the API, identify and validate test points, and ignore resource paths which are not to be tested.</p>
<p id="_682dabac-6fa9-f1eb-55b9-a6d582d9cce5">The following requirement applies for a server implementing the OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core under test:</p>
<table class="recommend" id="req_core_test-process" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Requirement A.1</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/req/core/test-process</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p id="_f7ea6e18-3c7e-33e1-d83f-5bad15af9a27">If a server implementing the OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core is tested using CITE tests, the server SHALL offer at least one testable process. Please refer to <a href="#rec_core_test-process">Annex A.1, Recommendation A.1</a> for further guidance.</p></td></tr></tbody></table>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_core_test-process" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation A.1</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/core/test-process</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p id="_4927ca30-8763-d8ac-7116-200cfc58a65d">If a server implementing the OGC API — Processes — Part 1: Core is tested using CITE tests, the server SHOULD offer one of the following options:</p><ol id="_984b753c-8d29-fd41-3c88-a80194b22392" type="1">
<li>
<p id="_9f30cf2d-5acd-200e-b410-569f7478c6c4">An Echo process that returns any input that is provided, without any actual processing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="_4e93727e-ee46-c01c-1df9-04e82995280f">Provide example input data for a specific process.</p>
</li>
</ol><p id="_73a229fa-83dc-f1fc-2ee3-29d2872bdcdf">The process logic SHOULD include a delay, whether through actual processing or a simple sleep mechanism, in order to test asynchronous execution.</p></td></tr></tbody></table></div>
